extraction.name: cleaned YODAS
extraction.description: A curated dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, created by cleaning the large-scale web-crawled YODAS dataset to improve Open Whisper-style Speech Models (OWSM).
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.inLanguage: eng, spa, rus, por, kor, fra, deu, ita, vie, ind
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is created by integrating and cleaning YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset, using a scalable data-cleaning pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data comes from YODAS, which crawls data from the web and provides unsegmented long-form recordings accompanied by text transcriptions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: (1) Resegmentation: realigning audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm with a pre-trained OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, segmenting into utterances of max 30 seconds, and removing non-speech elements. (2) LID-based filtering: performing language identification on audio (ECAPA-TDNN) and text (fastText) and retaining utterances where both match the original label. (3) CTC-score-based filtering: removing utterances with low-quality audio-text alignments by discarding long-form utterances if any constituent short utterance falls within the lowest 10% (θCTC = 0.10) CTC confidence score.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: (1) realign audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm, (2) filter data based on LID results from both audio and text, and (3) filter data based on CTC confidence scores.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The raw YODAS dataset provides unsegmented long-form recordings accompanied by a list of text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OWSM-CTC v3.2 model for CTC segmentation, fastText for text-based LID, and ECAPA-TDNN (SpeechBrain) for spoken LID.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper discusses concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility associated with closed models like Whisper, and motivates the development of fully open Whisper-style speech models to advance open research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced, with English constituting the largest share while many other languages are underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw data contains annotation errors, mismatched language labels, and audio-text misalignments. The cleaned dataset retains a highly imbalanced language distribution.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training speech foundation models for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), speech translation (ST), and spoken language identification (LID).
